program.blurb: Shoulders, ass and abs that look good with nothing on: lifts, a burn, then a stretch before you fuck her.
program.about: For what shows when her hands pull your clothes off: toned shoulders, a round ass and a flat stomach she can run her mouth down. One day pairs glute work with shoulder raises; the next is abs and legs; the third is a HIIT circuit with a long stretch after it. Level II adds reps and Level III asks for heavier weights.
